name: M320
summary: M320 is an extremely potent and long acting opioid. It produces long lasting narcosis in different animals, including mice, rats, cats, guinea pigs, dogs and monkeys. M320 is a μ and κ-opioid receptor agonist. Similarly to TL 2636, M320 tends to produce pronounced nausea and vomiting due to its potent agonist activity at both the μ and κ-opioid receptors at the same time.

pharmacology.text: M320 is a μ and κ-opioid receptor agonist.

uses.en: It is a research compound studied in animals and has never been a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是只在動物身上研究過的研究用化合物，從未成為藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它是只在动物身上研究过的研究用化合物，从未成为药品。

sideEffects.en: In animals it causes long-lasting deep sedation and pronounced nausea and vomiting. Like other very strong opioids, it would be expected to slow or stop breathing, which can be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 在動物身上它會造成長時間的深度鎮靜，以及明顯的噁心與嘔吐。和其他極強效的鴉片類一樣，可預期它會使呼吸減慢甚至停止，可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在动物身上它会造成长时间的深度镇静，以及明显的恶心与呕吐。和其他极强效的鸦片类一样，可预期它会使呼吸减慢甚至停止，可能致命。

fact.en: M320 is an orvinol, one of the family of very strong opioids made from thebaine by Kenneth Bentley's team in the 1960s, the same family that produced etorphine and buprenorphine.
fact.zh: M320 屬於奧維諾類，這類極強效的鴉片類藥物是肯尼斯．本特利的團隊在1960年代以蒂巴因為原料製成，埃托啡與丁基原啡因也出自同一家族。
fact.zhHans: M320 属于奥维诺类，这类极强效的鸦片类药物是肯尼斯．本特利的团队在1960年代以蒂巴因为原料制成，埃托啡与丁基原啡因也出自同一家族。
